title: Industrial Safety
description:
Studied the principles of industrial safety and occupational health, focusing on identifying workplace hazards, evaluating risks, and developing safety measures in manufacturing environments.

Key Topics Covered:

Hazard Identification: Recognizing potential safety hazards associated with industrial operations, equipment, and working conditions.

Risk Assessment: Evaluating workplace risks and identifying appropriate preventive and corrective measures.

Occupational Safety Standards: Understanding OSHA-based safety requirements and workplace safety practices.

Personal Protective Equipment (PPE): Identifying protective equipment requirements for different workplace hazards.

Emergency Preparedness: Developing emergency action procedures and workplace response plans.

Safety Management Programs: Understanding hazard communication, respiratory protection, confined space safety, and workplace safety policies.

Knowledge Gained:

Developed an understanding of how structured safety programs support hazard prevention, regulatory awareness, and safer industrial operations.

Applied industrial safety principles in an academic project to develop a manufacturing plant safety program covering emergency procedures, PPE, respiratory protection, hazard communication, and confined space safety.
